title: Cups on the Windowsill
story: For a class test, Ben put three cups of water on the windowsill. One sat in the sun, one in the shade, and one under foil. He checked them every hour and wrote the results. The sun cup lost the most water. The foil cup lost the least. Ben learned that heat makes water evaporate faster. He drew a simple chart.

vocabulary.definition: The flat shelf at the bottom of a window.
A thin metal sheet used as a cover.
What you find at the end of a test.
To change from water into vapour.
A simple drawing that shows information.
